youtube_description:
Singapore Bootcamp features the journey of 7 expats building a life for themselves in Singapore. This web series brings you the ultimate how-to guide on all things Singaporean.

What happens when a class full of foreigners discuss our local hawker culture? They play a round of charades! Watch to see their solid performance.
